name: sap-mock
description: Mock SAP purchasing with fictional data for demos: read purchase orders and alternative suppliers, and post expedite requests or supplier inquiries through a two-step gate (draft first, then submit with a confirmation token). In memory only; restart the agent to reset.

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders (demo data), filter by buyer, vendor, plant or status.

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order with vendor performance and the ZZ_EXPEDITE_FLAG custom field.

tools.name: list_alternative_suppliers
tools.description: Qualified alternative suppliers for a material.

tools.name: draft_expedite_request
tools.description: Prepare an expedite request. Changes nothing; returns a draft and a confirmation token.

tools.name: draft_supplier_inquiry
tools.description: Prepare an inquiry to an alternative supplier. Changes nothing; returns a draft and a confirmation token.

tools.name: submit_draft
tools.description: The only write: posts a draft once, after explicit approval. Needs the confirmation token and confirmed=true.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Every draft, submission and rejection since the server started.

audit_log_path.title: Audit log file
audit_log_path.description: Optional. Absolute path of a file that receives one JSON line per draft, submission and rejection. Leave empty to keep the log in memory only.
